android.desc:
LazyReader is a clean, distraction-free reader for your ebooks AND your audiobooks, and it reads them straight from your cloud storage - nothing to import, transfer or duplicate.

CONNECT YOUR CLOUD
Link Dropbox, OneDrive or Nextcloud and your library appears instantly. LazyReader reads your books right where they already are, and keeps your place in sync across sessions and devices.

STREAM AUDIOBOOKS FROM THE CLOUD
Got a 1 GB audiobook sitting in your cloud? Just press play. LazyReader streams M4B audiobooks directly, so there is no need to download a 1 GB book to your device before you can listen. Chapters, sleep timer, playback speed, lock screen controls, and a bookmark left wherever the sleep timer stopped you. Save a book for offline listening only when you actually want to.

ONE BOOK, TWO EDITIONS
Own the ebook and the audiobook? Link them and they become a single entry on your shelf. Read on the train, listen while you cook, and pick the other edition up at the same chapter. Notes and character lists you make while listening stay with the book.

A DISTRACTION-FREE READER
Adjustable fonts, themes and brightness, plus library views that suit you - list, grid, or grouped by author. No ads, no noise. Just you and your book.

READ ALOUD
Have any EPUB read to you with text-to-speech: sentence highlighting as it goes, adjustable voice and speed, and a sleep timer that bookmarks exactly where it stopped.

LOOK UP A WORD WITHOUT LEAVING THE PAGE
Long-press any word for a built-in offline dictionary. No internet, no third-party app, no leaving your book.

NOTES, HIGHLIGHTS AND SEARCH
Highlight passages in colour, attach notes to them, and search inside a book for any word or passage. It all syncs with your account.

COLLECTIONS
Group your books into collections that match how you actually read.

INTERACTIVE FICTION, LITRPG & GAMEBOOKS
LazyReader is also a home for interactive stories. Play branching interactive novels and LitRPG adventures where your choices shape the narrative. Explore different paths, track your stats and variables, and unlock multiple endings - a modern take on choose-your-own-adventure gamebooks.

FREE CLASSICS
Browse and download free public-domain ebooks from the built-in classics catalogue, straight into your library.

READ AND LISTEN OFFLINE
Save ebooks and audiobooks to your device and take the lot with you, connection or not.

quotes.text:
I built LazyReader because I was tired of re-importing the same ebook library whenever I switched devices or reading apps.

Most reading apps copy your books into their own storage. LazyReader connects directly to your existing cloud storage, so your books stay where they already are.

It supports Dropbox, OneDrive, and Nextcloud. You can browse your library and read EPUBs directly from the cloud, and it now also supports streaming audiobooks directly from cloud storage. So if you have a 1GB M4B audiobook, you don't need to download the entire file to your phone before listening.

Since the original version, LazyReader has grown into a much more complete reading app:

- EPUB and audiobook support
- Library and reading-progress synchronization
- Collections and sorting
- EPUB and audiobook edition linking
- Offline reading and listening
- Offline dictionary
- Word and phrase search
- Notes and highlighting
- Text-to-speech
- Theming
- Multiple cover-enrichment options
- Book metadata editing
- QR-code book sharing
- Interactive/choice-driven EPUB support

The interactive EPUB support is probably one of the more unusual parts. EPUBs can contain much more structure than a typical linear ebook, so LazyReader can handle branching and choice-driven books as well as conventional EPUBs.
